notes.title: Spring Sale 20% Off! New Lottery Tickets Update!
notes.notes:
Translation to English:

Greetings, fellow whales! Lao Wang has missed you all so much! Recently, I’ve noticed how much you’ve been enjoying the ​Lottery Mode—scratching those tickets day and night with pure joy. So, to pamper my loyal fans, I’m adding ​TWO brand-new lottery tickets to keep the scratching frenzy alive!

Plus, for the ​Spring Sale, Chinese Online Game is now ​20% OFF! The ​Mount and Wing Bundles are also discounted for the first time—20% OFF, just like the base game! Patient gamers who waited, now’s the time to grab these deals and join Lao Wang in conquering the sand city!

1、Fixed the bug of abnormal installation of the pocket version in the cool mode.
2、Fixed the bug that daily consumption gift packs cannot be purchased.
3、Optimized the chance that the park can't trigger relatives to give money

Once again, thank you for your love and support for “Chinese-style online game”, and would like to emphasize again to tell you that we have not given up the game, and still continue to develop new content!

notes.title: The major update [Sharp Mode] DLC is available for free today!
notes.notes:
Sorry in advance for the wait! Thanks to all the Kryptonians for their love and support of Chinese Style Online Games! 
Thank you all for your positive feedback to make this [Sharp Mode] DLC possible! We've also decided to release this DLC for free, and we hope you all have a great time on the National Day holiday! 

The main update content overview:
1、Free launch of [Sharp Mode] DLC - new plot, 6+ new kryptonite gameplay, endless mode, 100 consecutive draws and other content!
2、Launch [Kryptonite Exclusive Gift Pack] mount paid DLC ($12)
Note: The content of this gift pack is only the mount skin will not have a direct numerical impact on the game. Non-compulsory, rational purchase! Thank you for your love and support of “Chinese-style online game”
3, the launch of the game body + Sharp mode DLC + mount gift pack DLC bundle, the integrated discount 20% off!
4、Game body open 10% discount


Detailed update content

First, [cool mode] DLC content is as follows:
(All of the new content in this DLC update will be available in the “Sharp Mode”)

New
New [Mount System]: Players can purchase about 8 different kinds of mounts in the game mall to enhance their combat power.
2、New [Gem Lucky Draw System]: A brand new kryptonite system, which can end the problem of low gem output of players.
3、New [Super Skill Gameplay]: Inner elixir system to upgrade combat power.
4、New [Gang Construction Play]: Players can purchase gang infrastructure to enhance combat power.
5、New [Destiny Man Hidden System]: According to the plot advancement, players will get the ultimate prize if they find 3 colored eggs.
6、New [beautiful customer service system]: beautiful customer service will guide the “destiny” players to continue to “kryptonite” gold.
7. Added [Red Face System]: one of the kryptonite systems.
8, added [mansion plate]: players new home “mansion”.
9、New [Luxury Mall]: players can buy luxury goods in the luxury mall.
10、New [Private Secretary]: players can be calmed.
11、New [TV] content: players can see certain kryptonite cases on TV.


Optimization and adjustment
1、[100连抽]: Players can now do 100 consecutive draws.
2、[AI System Optimization]: AI players will behave more politely in the game than in “Reality Mode”.
3、[Endless Mode]: In “Sharp Mode”, the player will not end the game according to the plot after becoming the city lord, the time will be fixed at 9.30, and the player can still continue to experience the game.
4、[Optimize King's Emotional Stability]: Optimize King's emotion, so that he won't be so easy to crash in “cool text” mode.
5、[Company System Optimization]: Players will not need to go to the company to work after triggering the storyline in the “Cool Text” mode.

Your support is my motivation to update and maintain the game!

notes.title: Scheduled for release on July 19th!
notes.notes:
Hello, honorable Kryptonians! Since the demo was released on New Product Day, many Kryptonians have been saying "hurry up, hurry up, hurry up, hurry up, hurry up, hurry up, hurry up, hurry up, hurry up, hurry up, hurry up, hurry up, hurry up! I want to play the official version!

Now we can finally announce that the game is officially scheduled for release on July 19, and this time it's finally the official version and not a demo!

We've also prepared the latest PV trailer for the game:
https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1rz421B7Rr/

Chinese online game" is a 18-year project, R & D "Tao" a person to take over all the programs, planning, art of special significance of the game, and now finally will soon be able to official version of the full content of the form of speed to you "Kryptonite" up. Since the new product festival, players feedback a lot of problems, we are also doing the final optimization preparation and sprint, hope that in the official version to bring you not only a better game experience:


【Newly optimized game experience】
In the player community, many players have complained that "kryptonite is too slow", "can not be more kryptonite at a time", of course, the player's feedback we have been reading, the main one to listen to advice!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850782/301408a4628db3478ddff34acc5adc3a82fa9905.jpg

【More level volume, special gameplay and hidden storylines】
The official version will be accompanied by subsequent richer levels (40+ levels in 10 chapters in total) and different copy bosses, as well as content that advances with the game's timeline: rotating every 15 days, containing a total of 6 seasons with different play and kryptonite experiences!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850782/c44451f7e45f52701d103aa409c2782791262ae5.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44850782/3958b97543e45413d5a4b40d60f10f624551b3b1.png

With the release date approaching, the R & D also embrace the same expectations and apprehension, in addition to continue to optimize the sprint work, we will also actively understand and listen to everyone's ideas and suggestions. Because the game is developed independently by one person, time and energy are relatively limited, or would like to say thank you for your understanding and support and companionship!

notes.title: Demo version delay testing announcement!
notes.notes:
Hi respected VIP15, respected "Kryptonites", hello everyone!

Yesterday, many players reported that the demo was taken down and cannot be played. I'm sorry for letting everyone run out of time. We have reviewed the feedback from everyone and, in response to the call of the majority of players, have decided to postpone the Steam Demo version testing to June 28th at 23:59:59 and close it. Thank you for your love of the game. We are also rushing to work on the official version, and we will see you again in July!
